content:
There once was a cat named Whiskers who drove a Kia,
In a race to win, he raced with all his might.
But oh no! The car wouldn't stop, it kept going fast,
And Whiskers had to slow down, or risk a crash.

He tried to turn around, but the brakes were stuck tight,
So he had to keep driving, hoping for a way out.
But then something magical happened, the Kia started to fly,
And Whiskers was able to finish the race with a smile.
